posts.name: Shay Boloor
posts.text:
$NVDA is reportedly exploring a ~$25B acquisition of Reflection AI with the startup already committed to ~$7.3B of compute through $SPCX and $NBIS.

What makes this interesting is Nvidia could own open model layer on top of CUDA keeping more enterprise and sovereign AI workloads running on its hardware as Chinese models gain ground.
